Drone Volt launches HERCULES 100 cargo drone

The manufacturer claims up to 100 kilograms of payload and 30 minutes of flight.

Drone Volt / WebDisclosure ↗9 October 2026English editorial summary
Story

A Bordeaux unveiling

Drone Volt announced a flight unveiling at the October 9 UAV Show. The eight-rotor platform has a 197-kilogram maximum takeoff weight and folds for pickup-truck transport.

Cargo options

The claimed 30 minutes with 100 kilograms depends on weather and operating conditions. Options include an 80-kilogram winch and an automatic hook with a 30-metre sling.

Operational readiness

Proposed uses include remote-site supplies and emergency logistics. Operational concepts and risk assessments are still being prepared for authorization; the launch does not authorize unrestricted flights.
